exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: What job would you like to have ten years from now? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: How useful will English be for your future? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: How much travelling do you hope to do in the future? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: How do you think your life will change in the future? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a book that you enjoyed reading because you had to think a lot. You should say: what this book was why you decided to read it what reading this book made you think about and explain why you enjoyed reading this book.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: What are the most popular types of children's books in your country?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: What are the benefits of parents reading books to their children?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Should parents always let children choose the books they read?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: How popular are electronic books in your country?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: What are the advantages of parents reading electronic books (compared to printed books)?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Will electronic books ever completely replace printed books in the future?
